headline: Connect Eastron through HomeWizard
intro: Home Assistant identifies Eastron as a virtual integration supported by HomeWizard. Its pinned component contains a manifest and an empty package initializer, so the entry points to HomeWizard rather than defining a separate Eastron setup flow here.
highlights: The manifest names the integration Eastron and declares its type as virtual
The manifest's supported_by field points to HomeWizard
The package initializer labels Eastron as virtual and defines no additional behavior
